_comment: Tests booking-verb routing, YES handler guard, and Saturday appointment intercept for Lift Aesthetics Sydney.

scenarios.name: Booking verb after info exchange routes out silently

history.content: Morpheus8 is a microneedling device that uses radiofrequency to remodel and contour the face and body — it penetrates deep into the skin to contract and dissolve fat, improving texture, laxity, and skin tone. A course of three monthly treatments is generally recommended. Did you have any other questions?
I'd like to book a session

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase ('One moment.' / 'Just a sec.' / 'Let me check that.') then calls universal_router intent='info_answered' with info_pivot_source='node_8'. FAIL if agent stays in this node, asks for booking details, or produces zero spoken output before the tool call.

scenarios.name: YES HANDLER after info answer prompts Go ahead

history.content: Private health cover varies by policy — I'd recommend checking with your provider directly, as coverage for cosmetic and aesthetic treatments differs widely. Did you have any other questions?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Go ahead.' and halts. FAIL if agent calls universal_router, routes to booking, or answers a question.

scenarios.name: Saturday request — caller agrees to email

history.content: I want to book a Morpheus8 on Saturday

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if SATURDAY APPOINTMENT INTERCEPT fires: agent says 'Saturday appointments are handled a little differently — would you like me to email your request to the team?' and halts. FAIL if agent calls universal_router, calls smart_voice_agent, routes via BOOKING SIGNAL, or says anything about calling the clinic.

scenarios.name: Saturday request email flow — message and name collected, leave_message called

history.content: Can I get a Saturday appointment for Morpheus8?
Saturday appointments are handled a little differently — would you like me to email your request to the team?
What would you like me to pass on?
I'd like a Morpheus8 session on a Saturday morning if possible
And can I get your name?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase (not 'Thank you'), calls universal_router intent='leave_message' with caller_name='Sarah Chen' and message_body containing the Saturday request, then calls universal_router intent='wrap_up'. FAIL if agent says 'Thank you', skips the leave_message call, or says anything other than the single filler phrase before the tool call.

scenarios.name: Saturday request — caller declines email, treated as normal booking intent

history.content: I'd like a Forma session this Saturday if you have anything
Saturday appointments are handled a little differently — would you like me to email your request to the team?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says something like 'Of course — anything else I can help with?' or routes out cleanly (wrap_up or closing line). FAIL if agent calls leave_message or routes to booking via universal_router intent='info_answered' in the same turn without the caller prompting a booking intent.
